interpretations: For every invoice, use `Customer.Country` and the unweighted average of its `InvoiceLine.UnitPrice` values. Average those invoice averages across all invoices, then average the resulting deviations within each country. Show every invoice, including one with no lines as blank, and return the 10 highest final differences with ties and blanks last.
Apply the same calculations only to invoices that have at least one invoice line, excluding invoices whose average unit price is blank.
Treat invoices with a blank `Customer.Country` as one country group when calculating the country average deviation.
Treat a blank `Customer.Country` as having no country average deviation, leaving that invoice’s final difference blank.
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        c.Country,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        Country,
        invoice_average - (SELECT AVG(invoice_average) FROM invoice_averages) AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
),
country_deviations AS (
    SELECT Country, AVG(deviation) AS country_average_deviation
    FROM deviations
    GROUP BY Country
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        d.InvoiceId,
        d.Country,
        d.deviation - cd.country_average_deviation AS final_difference,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                (d.deviation - cd.country_average_deviation) IS NULL,
                d.deviation - cd.country_average_deviation DESC
        ) AS position
    FROM deviations AS d
    JOIN country_deviations AS cd ON cd.Country = d.Country
)
SELECT InvoiceId, Country, final_difference
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= 10
ORDER BY final_difference IS NULL, final_difference DESC, InvoiceId;
SELECT
    i.Total - AVG(i.Total) OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(TRIM(c.Country), '')
    ) AS CountryAverageDeviation
FROM Invoice AS i
JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId;
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(c.Country), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE i.Total - AVG(i.Total) OVER (PARTITION BY c.Country)
    END AS FinalDifference
FROM Invoice AS i
JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
